name: Futago no Toriko ~Koisuru Idol~
original_name: フタゴノトリコ～恋するアイドル～
source:
Tetsushi Takashima (name changeable), a producer for a recently debuted idol duo, is riding high after their latest single tops the charts. Feeling generous, he makes a careless promise: “I’ll grant any wish you have!”
He still thinks of the idols as kids, but they’ve grown into full-fledged women.
“Give us the right to do whatever we want with you, Producer,” they say, and soon, they’re using every trick in the book to serve him in ways he never expected.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ014556.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
Tetsushi Takashima（姓名可更改）是一对新出道偶像组合的制作人。她们的最新单曲登上排行榜榜首，让他兴奋不已，得意之下随口许诺。“不管你们有什么愿望，我都答应！”
他仍把两位偶像当作孩子，可她们早已长成了真正的女人。
“制作人，请给我们对你为所欲为的权利吧。”两人如此说道，随即使出浑身解数，以他意想不到的方式侍奉起他来。
